source: Adapted from the seven styles of kaventro/motion-designer (MIT), mapped to the Studio motion contract; see README.md

styles.name: Brand-native
styles.when: the brand or product has a strong look of its own
styles.tokens_rule: Take background, foreground, muted, accent and fontFamily from the brand's tokens, theme or approved guidelines; the canvas may be the brand background a shade lighter or darker.
styles.motion_rule: Follow the product's own motion (its springs and durations) when known; otherwise start from the closest style below.

signature.move: the brand's most recognisable shape carries the video from scene to scene

music.texture: from the brand's existing sound or music, if any

styles.name: Meadow
styles.when: finance, health, family, everyday consumer products

signature.move: a small brand dot that becomes the subject and returns to the wordmark at the end

music.texture: warm and acoustic: nylon guitar, Rhodes, felt piano, soft drums

styles.name: Warm ink

signature.move: rows and panels assemble with an ink connector, and the ending closes back into the first shape

music.texture: dry and clean: muted keys, soft electric bass, tight drums

styles.note: Use the accent only where the subject itself uses colour; ink is the default accent.

styles.name: Midnight
styles.when: technology, developer tools, launches with a dark interface, games

signature.move: a line of light (the accent) that marks now and runs through every scene
signature.engine: line-reveal with params.exit 'sweep' and sweepColor set to the accent

styles.note: The accent means one thing: now, or just changed. Keep backgrounds flat; soft gradients on dark band in H.264.

styles.name: Field guide
styles.when: outdoors, travel, food, maps and routes

signature.move: the route line: a line that draws itself, connects the points and underlines the final statement
signature.engine: item-stagger connector for the route; end-card rule for the underline

music.texture: acoustic and organic: guitar, light percussion, room

signature.move: one oversized line at a time (at most six words) ending in an accent full stop
signature.engine: line-reveal at 140-180 px; the coloured full stop needs custom code

music.texture: sparse: piano or plucked notes with space for the words

styles.name: Color block
styles.when: consumer launches, social posts, community, games

signature.move: the canvas colour changes on bar lines with a wipe (yellow #FFD23F, blue #3A86FF, pink #FF5D8F)
signature.engine: params.background on every scene with backgroundWipe; see examples/color-block.motion-score.json
